title: Vati API behind WSO2 API Manager and sign-in through WSO2 Identity Server
scope: Local smoke test of the ADR-040 plug-in path: WSO2 Identity Server as OIDC provider for Frappe staff and taxpayer login mapped to existing roles and tenant membership, and the Vati /api/v1 service published through WSO2 API Manager

acceptance.text: Pin WSO2 Identity Server and API Manager versions from official WSO2 documentation and record them in ADR-040 and the upstream lock; configuration lives in the repo with secrets only in ignored files

An OIDC login through WSO2 IS reaches Frappe as an existing user with unchanged roles and tenant permissions; an unknown subject gets no access; the Frappe local login path still works as the fallback

A /api/v1 call through WSO2 API Manager reaches the Vati service with the user's identity and is refused without it; a recorded smoke test is attached, or, if resources prevent it, the limitation is recorded as a reduced demonstration without claiming integration
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: A /api/v1 call through WSO2 API Manager reaches the Vati service with the user's identity and is refused without it; a recorded smoke test is attached, or, if resources prevent it, the limitation is recorded as a reduced demonstration without claiming integration

notes.text: Added 2026-11-06 from the framework scope update (docs/reference/FRAMEWORK.md, ADR-040) as a must-have for the proposal and pilot.
